title: Gaussian tail integral identity
statement:
Let $\mu,t\in\mathbb{R}$ and let $v>0$. If $g_{\mu,v}$ denotes the Gaussian density with mean $\mu$ and parameter $v$, then
\[\int_t^\infty (x-\mu)g_{\mu,v}(x)\,dx=v\,g_{\mu,v}(t).\]
